mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 10% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings growth and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods where UNRATE exceeds 10% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when GDPC1 declines by more than 2% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 1% signals improved labor market conditions and higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero when PAYEMS growth exceeds 1% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) of more than 1% combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) of more than 10% signals broad demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 1% and HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when both GDPC1 declines > 1% and HOUST declines > 10% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% signals improved manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero when INDPRO rises by more than 1% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% combined with a 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 1% signals a tight labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS growth > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero when UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 1% over three months (t-test p > 0.05).
